action.sql: SELECT d.dept_id, d.name AS department_name, SUM(g.debit - g.credit) AS operating_expense FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON g.account_id = a.account_id JOIN departments d ON g.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'US01' AND g.period = '2026-05' AND a.type = 'Expense' AND a.account_id BETWEEN '6000' AND '6999' GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.name ORDER BY d.dept_id
